title: Leftward search for a tape boundary
statement: For an alphabet of symbols, a number $k$ of work tapes, and a selected tape $i$ among them, define a machine with phases run, gap, back, and done. It starts in run; while scanning tape $i$, it moves left and remains in run on a nonblank symbol, and moves left into gap on a blank. In gap it moves left and returns to run on a nonblank symbol; on a blank it enters back without moving the input head. In back it moves right on tape $i$ and enters done; in done it stays in place. These transitions make no writes or outputs.
hypotheses_covered: A natural number $k$ of work tapes
A selected tape $i$ among the $k$ work tapes
